name: Raspberry Pi OS and boot media
description: Use Raspberry Pi Imager on Windows, macOS, or Linux to download and write Raspberry Pi OS or supported third-party images to microSD or compatible USB storage.
license_note: Review the OS image and third-party distribution licences individually.
notes: Most Raspberry Pi models commonly use microSD; some also support USB or NVMe boot.
Raspberry Pi Imager can verify written media.
Selecting storage and writing an image overwrites that target.
